description: Check exact package@version pairs against Shield intel: malware verdict (with review state) and CVEs affecting that version, including the first patched version. Works anonymously for packages you name (25 per call); Shield login raises the cap to 200. Domain data still requires login. Missing pairs were not scanned yet — absence is not a clean verdict.
name: shield_check_packages
title: Malware verdicts and CVEs for package versions
